basic_info.description: This stylish 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom condo plus office is ideally located in the heart of South Beach, featuring a large private balcony with sweeping city and Twin Peaks views. The open-concept living room showcases high ceilings, abundant natural light, a chef's kitchen, and hardwood floors throughout, motorized shades, updated bathroom and smart thermostat. One-car parking and storage unit included.  88 King St is a luxury condo building across the street from Oracle Park. Built in 2000, the building offers luxurious resort-style amenities, including a heated outdoor pool and spa, a sun deck with a full BBQ, fire pit, and heat lamps. Residents also enjoy a private fitness center, conference room, business center, and entertainment room. The location is prime. It's located just a block from the Embarcadero waterfront, entertainment, amazing restaurants, Safeway, and Whole Foods. Easy access to major freeways.
